Description
Founded in 1985, the ASC is one of the larger non-government schooling systems in Australia. With a staff of over 1,500, we educate 14,500 students in our 14 schools across three states of Australia. ASC schools are distinctly Christian communities that demonstrate care for each other and treat all people with dignity and respect.
Schools of the Anglican Schools Commission:
·       John Wollaston Anglican Community School, Kelmscott WA
·       John Septimus Roe Anglican Community School, Mirrabooka WA
·       Peter Carnley Anglican Community School, Calista WA
·       Peter Moyes Anglican Community School, Mindarie WA
·       St James’ Anglican School, Alkimos WA
·       St Mark’s Anglican Community School, Hillarys WA
·       Swan Valley Anglican Community School, Aveley WA
·       Cathedral College Wangaratta   Vic
·       Trinity Anglican College Thurgoona NSW 
·       ASC Language School., Perth WA
·       St Georges Anglican Grammar Perth WA
·       Cobram Anglican Grammar School, Cobram VIC
